aria_snapshot:
- main:
  - region "Would you mint it?":
    - paragraph: MINT DECISION TOOL
    - heading "Would you mint it?" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Run a mint through six blunt checks. Get a clear verdict and a receipt you can post—not vibes, not FOMO.
  - region "Mint checker":
    - heading "Build the case" [level=2]
    - text: 01 / INPUT PROJECT
    - textbox "PROJECT"
    - text: NETWORK
    - combobox "NETWORK":
      - option "Robinhood Chain" [selected]
      - option "Base"
      - option "Ethereum"
      - option "Polygon"
      - option "Solana"
      - option "Other"
    - text: MINT PRICE · USD
    - spinbutton "MINT PRICE · USD": "0"
    - text: EST. GAS · USD
    - spinbutton "EST. GAS · USD": "0.10"
    - text: YOUR PRICE CAP · USD
    - spinbutton "YOUR PRICE CAP · USD": "0.10"
    - text: Official route confirmed Link traces back to the real team or contract.
    - group "Official route confirmed":
      - button "YES"
      - button "NO"
    - text: Contract source verified Explorer shows verified, readable code.
    - group "Contract source verified":
      - button "YES"
      - button "NO"
    - text: No wallet approvals requested Transaction does not grant token or NFT control.
    - group "No wallet approvals requested":
      - button "YES"
      - button "NO"
    - text: Fresh simulation succeeds Expected recipient, quantity and value all match.
    - group "Fresh simulation succeeds":
      - button "YES"
      - button "NO"
    - text: Team history checks out No impersonator, delisting or rug warning found.
    - group "Team history checks out":
      - button "YES"
      - button "NO"
    - text: Demand looks organic Wallet spread beats a concentrated whale push.
    - group "Demand looks organic":
      - button "YES"
      - button "NO"
    - button "Run the gate"
    - button "Reset"
    - complementary:
      - text: WAITING FOR SIGNAL 02 / VERDICT HOLD
      - paragraph: Answer every gate to reveal the call.
      - list:
        - listitem: — No result yet. The board fails closed when facts are missing.
      - text: X-READY RECEIPT
      - textbox "X-READY RECEIPT": Run the gate to generate a compact mint verdict.
      - text: 48 characters
      - button "Copy receipt"
  - region "Method":
    - article:
      - text: THE FOIL RULE
      - blockquote: Missing proof is a “no,” not a maybe.
      - paragraph: This tool scores only what you enter. It does not inspect contracts, wallets or market data for you.
    - article:
      - heading "Six gates before one signature" [level=2]
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - strong: Price
          - text: Set the ceiling before the timeline gets loud.
        - listitem:
          - strong: Provenance
          - text: Start from the real team. Never trust reply links.
        - listitem:
          - strong: Contract
          - text: Read the destination and method on an explorer.
        - listitem:
          - strong: Permissions
          - text: A mint should not seize approval over your assets.
        - listitem:
          - strong: Simulation
          - text: Match value, quantity, recipient and resulting assets.
        - listitem:
          - strong: Distribution
          - text: Organic collectors beat one wallet painting demand.
